## Introduction

This report demonstrates basic R programming skills using an illustrative dataset of coral colony measurements.

## Coral Colony Measurements

The following R code creates a vector containing five example coral colony diameters measured in centimetres.

```{r}
coral_diameters <- c(12.5, 15.2, 10.8, 18.4, 14.1)

coral_diameters
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
mean(coral_diameters)
min(coral_diameters)
max(coral_diameters)
```

## Conclusion

R can be used to organise and summarise numerical measurements relevant to marine science.
